goal: Verify that the P4 Session Snapshot and Cold Closeout satisfy their requirements on the exact fixed Snapshot.

deliverables: Kernel-assigned --session-id derived from the Attempt ID; capture of the session transcript at seal into review.kernel/SessionSnapshot@1

Two-phase protocol under the Attempt epoch: capture and verify, prepared event with CAS ID, idempotent no-follow deletion from the harness directory, cleanup-completed event; recovery finishes cleanup without a provider call
Forked resume with --resume and --fork-session; a resume render mode that sends only the delta prompt; the manifest lists the transcript and the delta
Gates: provider support, previous Attempt age under warm.session.max_age, transcript estimated tokens fitting the reservation; any failure falls back to Notes only
Codex excluded from this package; --ephemeral retained
Cold Closeout compiled as a conditional cold Attempt of the same node inside the Round with a protected reservation
Schemas, parity fixtures, one ADR numbered after the latest, README index entry, CHANGELOG Unreleased entry
acceptance: A crash between capture and deletion recovers to a consistent state with no orphan and no ambient transcript
A resumed Attempt records cache-read tokens separately from input tokens
Cold Closeout dispatches only when the warm result would make the Round clean, and its reservation is protected
The policy default keeps the layer off
